اشتأيت (form VIII)
# اِشْتَأَيْتُ (ištaʔaytu) /iʃ.ta.ʔaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِشْتَأَى (ištaʔā)
# اِشْتَأَيْتَ (ištaʔayta) /iʃ.ta.ʔaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْتَأَى (ištaʔā)
# اِشْتَأَيْتِ (ištaʔayti) /iʃ.ta.ʔaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْتَأَى (ištaʔā)
